name: Novotel Wavre Brussels East
description: The most prestigious and convenient partner hotel for Walibi Belgium — Novotel Wavre Brussels East is an 11-minute walk from the park entrance and officially featured on Walibi's own accommodation page. This 4-star hotel offers 102 modern and spacious rooms with premium bedding and blackout curtains, a restaurant and bar, outdoor seasonal swimming pool, fitness centre, and 6 meeting rooms. With 200kW EV charging stations, free parking and a warm, family-friendly welcome from the team, Novotel Wavre is the finest overnight option for visitors combining a Walibi day with Belgian comfort. Guests consistently rate it 8.3 out of 10.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Modern superior room with king or twin beds, premium bedding, sofa bed option, laptop workspace and all Novotel amenities.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family room with communicating door option, large TV and all amenities. Ideal for families visiting Walibi Belgium.

name: ibis Wavre Brussels East
description: A smart, budget-friendly hotel officially featured on Walibi Belgium's accommodation page — entirely renovated since 2017, ibis Wavre is located just 2 kilometres from Walibi directly off the E411 motorway, making it one of the most accessible and affordable overnight options near the park. With clean, modern rooms, a 24-hour bar serving snacks, free parking and a location close to a Carrefour supermarket, ibis Wavre is the ideal practical choice for families wanting to maximise their park budget without sacrificing comfort.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable modern ibis room with double or twin beds, free WiFi and private bathroom. Clean and practical.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Larger room with additional beds for children, ideal for families visiting Walibi Belgium on a budget.

name: B&B La Ferme de l'Hoste
description: A charming and peaceful bed and breakfast officially featured on Walibi Belgium's accommodation page — La Ferme de l'Hoste is less than 4 kilometres from Walibi by car or train from Basse-Wavre station, set in a tranquil green countryside setting overlooking farm fields. After a long and exciting day at Walibi, guests can relax in the calm and welcoming atmosphere of this authentic Belgian farmhouse B&B, with comfortable rooms, local breakfast and the kind of personal hospitality that no chain hotel can provide. A wonderful contrast to the park's excitement.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.description: Comfortable farmhouse double room with garden views and local Belgian breakfast included.

rooms.name: Family Apartment
rooms.description: Spacious three-bedroom house suitable for families, with private garden and full kitchen facilities.
